basis.selection_reason: 011 执行与比较成功，使用该表已验证日期；优先 010 同题候选 / 共同兼容日，再按日期升序
basis.value_representation: Unmodified DuckDB CAST AS VARCHAR; SQL NULL is JSON null. Keys use the unchanged historical L0 normalization.

edits.new: CAST(CASE WHEN CAST(impressions AS INT) IS NULL OR CAST(impressions AS INT) <= 0 THEN 0.0 WHEN CAST(CASE WHEN clicks < 0 THEN 0 ELSE clicks END AS INT) IS NULL OR CAST(CASE WHEN clicks < 0 THEN 0 ELSE clicks END AS INT) < 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE ROUND((CAST(CAST(CASE WHEN clicks < 0 THEN 0 ELSE clicks END AS INT) AS DECIMAL(18, 3)) / CAST(CAST(impressions AS INT) AS DECIMAL(18, 3))) * 100, 4) END AS DOUBLE) AS click_through_rate

CAST(CASE WHEN CAST(CASE WHEN clicks < 0 THEN 0 ELSE clicks END AS INT) IS NULL OR CAST(CASE WHEN clicks < 0 THEN 0 ELSE clicks END AS INT) <= 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE ROUND(ROUND(CASE WHEN CAST(ROUND(CASE WHEN cost IS NULL THEN 0.0 WHEN cost < 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE cost END, 2) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) IS NULL THEN 0.0 WHEN CAST(ROUND(CASE WHEN cost IS NULL THEN 0.0 WHEN cost < 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE cost END, 2) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) < 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST(ROUND(CASE WHEN cost IS NULL THEN 0.0 WHEN cost < 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE cost END, 2) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) END, 2) / CAST(CASE WHEN clicks < 0 THEN 0 ELSE clicks END AS INT), 2) END AS DOUBLE) AS cost_per_click
